intentions.title: Mirror Barkpark tasks to GitHub Issues as a debounced, level-triggered, loop-immune outbound bridge
intentions.evidence: MirrorJob (Oban worker, unique per {doc_id,dataset}, 30s debounce) reads current task state and reconciles via Projection.task_to_issue/1 + Client.create_issue/update_issue/close_issue; DrainWorker + Outbox/Cursor feed it from mutation_events; Link.put stamps source: :github so the wave-1 outbox reader excludes github-sourced writes, structurally preventing the mirror from re-draining its own bookkeeping (D4 cut #2).

intentions.title: Make out-of-band drift on the GitHub side visible without ever letting GitHub values overwrite the Barkpark ledger
intentions.evidence: MirrorJob step 6 fingerprints title/body/labels/state via Client.get_issue/3 before PATCHing and calls Conflicts.record/1 on mismatch (kind out_of_band_edit); Conflicts module is DB-only and never touches Content.* or mutation_events, so a conflict record can never re-trigger sync; Client.get_issue moduledoc states the read is 'used ONLY to fingerprint... NEVER writes a GitHub value back into a task field' (charter D5). 'Ledger wins on disagreement, but disagreement is VISIBLE.'

intentions.title: Give operators an eyes-on console for sync health, backlog, and quarantined conflicts without any write surface risk
intentions.evidence: web/ops_live.ex mounts a read-only :ops-gated LiveView at /admin/github, polling Health.snapshot/1 every 5s (cursor/lag/pending, mirror queue depth, conflicts by kind); the sole mutation is a 'Resolve' button wired to Conflicts.resolve/1, explicitly scoped to the side table only so it can never re-open a loop surface.

intentions.title: Ingest inbound GitHub issues/webhooks into Barkpark tasks with an explicit human-consent gate before any outbound mirroring begins
intentions.evidence: intake.ex creates gh-<num> tasks in a state: "intake" link (no mirror consent); adopt.ex flips intake → adopted; MirrorJob explicitly cancels ({:cancel, :intake}) on state "intake" links so 'a pre-adoption Barkpark edit must NEVER PATCH the outsider's issue with our projection' (D13, pre-adoption mirror gate); signature.ex + inbound_events.ex authenticate and dedupe the webhook delivery path.

intentions.title: Resolve GitHub App credentials from OS env first, encrypted DB settings second, fabricating nothing, and fail closed if any required credential is missing
intentions.evidence: Settings.get_credentials/0 resolves each of repo/app_id/installation_id/private_key/webhook_secret/project_id/api_base per-field (env wins, DB row via Barkpark.Plugins.Settings falls back, else nil); active?/0 requires ALL required_keys present and non-blank ('fail-closed... A half-provisioned App... is worse than a dark one'); webhook_secret_cached/0 memoizes via persistent_term with a TTL so unauthenticated webhook probes can't force a DB+audit read per request.

intentions.title: Classify every GitHub REST/GraphQL failure into one fixed 4-type error set so callers can react deterministically (retry, snooze, cancel, dead-letter)
intentions.evidence: client.ex classify/7 maps 401→refresh-then-AuthError, 403/429 w/ rate headers→RateLimitError{retry_after}, 403 w/o headers→AuthError, 404/410→NotFound, 5xx (after max_retries)→NetworkError, GraphQL 200-with-errors→NetworkError{reason:{:graphql,_}}; errors.ex defines the fixed struct set (charter D8); MirrorJob's error classification section maps each type to an Oban outcome ({:snooze,_}, {:cancel,_}, {:error,_}).

intentions.title: Model native GitHub Projects v2 board state and sub-issue relations as a first-class projection layer atop the issue mirror
intentions.evidence: client.ex graphql/3 hits /graphql for Projects v2 (charter D10); add_sub_issue/4 links a child issue via POST .../sub_issues keyed on database id (charter D11), with 422 'already a sub-issue' treated as success by the Relations caller; projects.ex and relations.ex build on these primitives; projection.ex computes the desired issue shape (task_to_issue/1) purely, decoupled from the network call.

intentions.title: Let an admin operate the bridge (credentials, adoption, health) through both a CLI and Studio surface without duplicating logic
intentions.evidence: cli.ex (importance 41) exposes bp-side operator commands; web/ops_live.ex exposes the same Health.snapshot/1 + Conflicts.resolve/1 through Studio; both are thin wrappers over the shared Settings/Health/Conflicts modules rather than re-implementing resolution logic.
